```{r setup}
library(clintrace)
library(dplyr)
```

## Overview

`clintrace` helps you record and query the lineage of analysis variables
(especially ADaM) back to their SDTM sources. This is useful for regulatory
traceability and QC in clinical trial programming.

## 1. Load example source data

```{r}
dm <- load_example("dm")
ex <- load_example("ex")

head(dm)
head(ex)
```

## 2. Create a trace object

```{r}
tr <- new_trace(study_id = "ABC-123")
print(tr)
```

## 3. Classic workflow: derive then record

```{r}
adsl <- dm %>%
  mutate(
    AGEGR1 = case_when(
      AGE < 65 ~ "<65",
      AGE < 75 ~ "65-74",
      TRUE     ~ ">=75"
    )
  )

tr <- add_lineage(
  tr,
  target_dataset = "ADSL",
  target_variable = "AGEGR1",
  source_dataset = "DM",
  source_variable = "AGE",
  derivation_type = "derived",
  algorithm = "case_when: <65, 65-74, >=75",
  keys = "USUBJID"
)
```

## 4. Industry helpers

### Derive and record in one step

```{r}
res <- derive_with_trace(
  data = dm,
  trace = new_trace("ABC-123"),
  target_variable = "AGEGR1",
  expr = case_when(
    AGE < 65 ~ "<65",
    AGE < 75 ~ "65-74",
    TRUE     ~ ">=75"
  ),
  source_dataset = "DM",
  source_variable = "AGE",
  algorithm = "Age banding per SAP"
)

adsl2 <- res$data
tr2   <- res$trace
head(adsl2[, c("USUBJID", "AGE", "AGEGR1")])
```

### Attach lineage metadata to the dataset

```{r}
adsl2 <- attach_trace(adsl2, tr2)
retrieved <- get_trace(adsl2)
print(retrieved)
```

### Validate completeness

```{r}
val <- validate_trace(tr2)
val$valid
```

### Generate classic ADaM SRC* variables

```{r}
src_table <- src_vars_from_trace(tr2)
src_table
```

### HTML report

```{r, eval = FALSE}
# Requires knitr
trace_report(tr2, file = "adsl_lineage_report.html")
```

## 5. Batch recording

```{r}
batch_df <- data.frame(
  target_dataset = c("ADSL", "ADSL"),
  target_variable = c("SEXN", "SAFFL"),
  source_dataset = c("DM", "EX"),
  source_variable = c("SEX", "EXSTDTC"),
  derivation_type = c("derived", "flag"),
  algorithm = c("1=M, 2=F", "Y if any EX record"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

tr_batch <- add_lineage_batch(new_trace("ABC-123"), batch_df)
query_lineage(tr_batch)
```

These patterns are intended for production ADaM programs that use `admiral`
or custom code while still maintaining clear regulatory traceability.
